note: Read 2026-10-30. The age is the General Directorate of Traffic's own answer, published by the Saudi Press Agency on 15 December 2017 (its 45 questions and answers on traffic and women's driving): 18 for the private driving licence and motorcycles, 20 for public licences, with a temporary permit of at most a year from 17. The Traffic Law itself (laws.boe.gov.sa, moi.gov.sa) didn't answer from this egress, so this is a secondary source quoting the Directorate. The fee and the term weren't read in force: the Shura Council's approval of 2014 (SPA) of a fee of 20 riyals a year and a term of two to ten years is an approval of a draft amendment, not the law as enacted, so fee and validYears are null.

sources.title: 45 سؤالاً وجوابًا عن المرور وأمن الطرق وقيادة المرأة (Saudi Press Agency, 15 December 2017)
sources.said: نشرت الإدارة العامة للمرور وقيادة قوات أمن الطرق ، اليوم إجابات لعدد من الأسئلة ... إتمام سن الثامنة عشرة لرخصة القيادة الخاصة وقيادة الدراجات الآلية وإتمام سن العشرين لرخص القيادة العامة ومركبات الأشغال العامة
